jobs.description: Über Simplyright Simplyright hilft Menschen, die Ärger mit Abos, Kündigungen oder Inkasso-Schreiben haben. Viele Kundinnen und Kunden nutzen dafür unseren Service und unser Abo Simplyright+. Wenn dabei einmal etwas schiefläuft, soll sich sofort ein Mensch persönlich darum kümmern. Genau dafür suchen wir dich. Deine Aufgaben Du kümmerst dich ausschließlich um unzufriedene Kundinnen und Kunden. Das ist deine einzige Aufgabe. Du rufst Kunden mit einer Beschwerde schnell zurück, hörst zu und verstehst, was wirklich passiert ist. Du bringst Ruhe in angespannte Gespräche und findest gemeinsam mit dem Kunden eine faire Lösung. Du klärst offene Fragen intern mit unserem Team, zum Beispiel zu Abo, Kündigung, Rückerstattung oder Inkasso-Schreiben, und meldest dich verlässlich beim Kunden zurück. Du dokumentierst jeden Fall sauber in unserem Ticketsystem (Zendesk) und antwortest auch per E-Mail. Dein Ziel: Aus einem verärgerten Kunden wird ein zufriedener Kunde. Das bringst du mit Viel Einfühlungsvermögen und Geduld. Du bleibst ruhig, auch wenn es am Telefon mal laut wird. Gutes Deutsch für Telefongespräche. Ein Akzent ist überhaupt kein Problem, perfektes Deutsch brauchst du nicht. Du bist zuverlässig, denkst mit und hältst, was du versprichst. Idealerweise Erfahrung im Kundenservice, Beschwerdemanagement oder Callcenter. Quereinsteiger mit dem richtigen Gespür sind ebenfalls willkommen. Ein ruhiger Arbeitsplatz, stabiles Internet, PC oder Laptop und ein Headset. Wichtig – Arbeitsmittel: Ein Windows-Laptop oder Windows-PC sowie ein Headset werden nicht vom Arbeitgeber gestellt. Du bringst beides selbst mit und nutzt es für deine Arbeit. Das bieten wir 2.500 € Gehalt pro Monat. Arbeitszeiten: Montag - Freitag von 08:30 - 17:00 Uhr. 100 % Remote: Du arbeitest von überall auf der Welt. Vollzeit oder Teilzeit, Start ab sofort. jobs.description: kami adalah perusahaan yang bergerak di bidang retail dan layanan konsumen, yang dikenal dengan komitmen terhadap kualitas layanan dan kepuasan pelanggan. Kami sedang mencari individu yang antusias dan berdedikasi untuk bergabung dengan tim kami sebagai KASIR MINOL. Posisi ini sangat penting dalam menjaga kelancaran operasional toko dan memberikan pengalaman belanja yang menyenangkan bagi setiap pelanggan. Jika Anda memiliki semangat untuk bekerja dalam lingkungan yang dinamis dan penuh tantangan, kesempatan ini cocok untuk Anda. KASIR MINOL bertanggung jawab atas proses transaksi pembayaran pelanggan, baik melalui tunai maupun non-tunai. Tugas utama termasuk melayani pelanggan dengan sopan dan profesional, memastikan keakuratan pembayaran, menjaga kerapihan meja kasir, serta berkoordinasi dengan rekan kerja dalam menjalankan tugas sehari-hari. Selain itu, KASIR MINOL juga bertanggung jawab atas pengelolaan uang kas dan laporan harian yang akurat. Kemampuan dalam mengoperasikan mesin kasir dan sistem digital merupakan nilai tambah dalam posisi ini. Kami mencari kandidat yang telah menyelesaikan pendidikan SMA/SMK atau sederajat. Kemampuan komunikasi yang baik dan sikap ramah serta sabar merupakan kunci sukses dalam posisi ini. Kami membuka kesempatan bagi siapa pun yang ingin berkembang bersama kami dan berkontribusi dalam membangun kesuksesan perusahaan.

What are you waiting for?   Role: Senior Trading Manager Brand: Myprotein Reporting to: Ecommerce Director  Location: THG ICON 1, 7-9 Sunbank Lane, WA15 0AF (Fully Office Based)  As Senior Trading Manager for the UK, you will own the commercial performance of Myprotein s UK website, driving profitable growth through effective ecommerce trading, customer experience and onsite optimisation. You will set the UK ecommerce strategy, translating commercial objectives and customer insight into clear trading priorities. Combining strong commercial judgement with data-led decision-making, you will identify opportunities, drive performance and lead cross-functional teams to deliver growth. The Details Own UK website performance across revenue, traffic, conversion, AOV, margin and profitability. Set and deliver the UK ecommerce trading strategy, translating business targets into clear priorities and action plans. Drive onsite trading and optimisation across merchandising, navigation, search, landing pages and promotional activity. jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.description: About Kernel Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this? Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier. Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust. Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent Kernel ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. We have strong product-market fit: Ops, data, and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva, and Checkout already use Kernel across their enterprise systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them. We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators, and we are growing 12x YoY . The role You will own one of Kernel’s product areas end-to-end, working directly with the founders and the engineering team Own all stages from discovery to implementation for our core product areas and bets Data- and metrics-driven (without being obstinate about it) Tolerate (maybe even relish) ambiguity, and know when to make decisions quickly vs. when something needs more thought Bridge the link between our customers and our engineering team Help shape the product roadmap and vision for Kernel What we’re looking for We are looking for a full-stack product thinker who can own and lead product work from discovery to implementation. jobs.title: Lab Technician
jobs.description: About Fractile Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts. The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems. We’re looking for a detail-oriented Lab Technician to keep our Bristol labs running safely and reliably. You’ll support hardware engineers with testing, setup and equipment upkeep in a fast-paced AI hardware company. Spun out of SCHUNK, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup. This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now. Your work will contribute to turning advanced robotics into reliable, manufacturable and deployable technology for real-world industrial applications. Don't see the right role? We're always interested in meeting people who want to help shape the future of robotics and Physical AI, whether your expertise lies in: Engineering & Robotics: Mechanical engineering, electronics, actuators, embedded systems, controls, robotics and system integration. Software & AI: Robotics software, machine learning, perception, motion planning and software development. Product & Industrialisation: Product development, testing, manufacturing, quality, reliability and technical operations. Business & Commercial: Business development, sales, marketing, partnerships and customer success. Operations & Corporate Functions: Supply chain, finance, people, administration and other areas that help a growing company succeed. Tell us a little about yourself, your experience and what you'd like to contribute to TACTILIA. Share your CV and, if available, your LinkedIn profile. jobs.title: CFD Workflow Automation Intern
jobs.description: About Pangea Propulsion: We are a company dedicated to developing advanced propulsion systems for the space industry based on three key principles: high efficiency, sustainability, and reusability. We are revolutionizing the space industry with ground-breaking innovations that allow us to offer the best performance to cost propulsion systems. Our goal is to be the propulsion provider for the next generation of spacecraft, which is essential to meet demands and compete in the booming space market of the next decade. We are a passionate, multicultural, and multidisciplinary team pushing the boundaries of what is possible in space propulsion technology. We have already made history by successfully testing the world's first 3D-printed Methalox Aerospike engine, marking a significant milestone for the space industry. We are looking for talented professionals to join our international teams in Barcelona and Toulouse. We want to be a key player in improving diversity in the Aerospace sector as, in Pangea, we believe that diversity (gender, age, race, sexual orientation, beliefs, disability, culture, etc.) is a key to success. Within Pangea, everyone can grow with the same opportunities. We encourage you to apply. Individually we are different, but together we are an amazing team! We are looking for a CFD Workflow Automation Intern for a 6-month internship in Toulouse. About the role: We are seeking a highly skilled intern with a strong programming background and an interest in engineering simulation to help automate repetitive CFD activities across the Turbomachinery Fluidic Design Team and the Fluidic Analysis Team. The role will focus on developing robust, reusable workflows for meshing, simulation setup and launching, data extraction, post-processing, and standardized reporting, with particular emphasis on Cadence and Ansys Fluent environments. The internship is intended to reduce manual effort, improve repeatability, and shorten analysis turnaround time across the Flui

jobs.title: Stage - Chimie des matériaux et des surfaces pour la microfluidique
jobs.description: Qui sommes-nous ? Bienvenue chez Maison MGA une entreprise où l’innovation rencontre l’excellence humaine. Rejoindre notre équipe, c’est vivre une aventure professionnelle portée par la bienveillance, le challenge, la progression continue… et une bonne dose de convivialité ! Tu intégreras notre entité MGA MedTech basé à Mably (42) spécialisée dans le développement de solutions technologiques avancées dédiées au secteur médical et des dispositifs médicaux. Pourquoi nous avons besoin de toi ? Pour accompagner notre développement, nous proposons un stage de 4 à 6 mois en Chimie des matériaux et des surfaces pour la microfluidique. Ton environnement et mission principale Sous la responsabilité du Single Use Manager, tu interviens sur le développement de matériaux et de traitements de surface pour la fabrication et l’assemblage de puces microfluidiques en polymères. Pour cela, tu auras l’opportunité de : Réaliser un état de l’art et évaluer des matériaux pour la réalisation de moules de microfabrication. Caractériser la durabilité des moules, leur fidélité de réplication et leur compatibilité avec les procédés de moulage. Développer des procédés de collage de puces thermoplastiques (PMMA, COC, COP) et valider leur étanchéité. Développer et caractériser des procédés de fonctionnalisation de surface (traitements plasma, silanisation, greffage). ♂♀ Et toi dans tout ça ? Tu es étudiant.e en chimie, matériaux polymères ou physico-chimie des surfaces. Une expérience en caractérisation topographique (profilométrie, microscopie) serait un vrai plus. Tu maîtrises l’anglais technique : tu es à l’aise pour lire des publications scientifiques et des fiches techniques. Si tu aimes comprendre comment les choses fonctionnent et participer au développement de technologies innovantes à impact, nous serons ravis d’échanger avec toi ! Tes avantages MGA Tickets restaurant de 9,50 euros - 60% pris en charge par l’employeur (à partir de 2 mois de stage) Prise en charge de 75% d’un abonnement

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description: At Superchat, we re rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. AI is becoming the engine of that communication. Integrations are what give that engine teeth: the data, the tools, the systems that turn a clever agent into one that actually closes loops. Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for 10,000+ businesses worldwide , from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day . We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams. We re 100 people , profitable , and have raised €18M in funding (last round 4.5 years ago, we ve been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin. We re looking for a Product Manager to join our Integrations team. In this role, you ll own the surface that decides whether our AI agents are clever demos or systems that actually do work. CRM sync, appointment bookings, call transfers, custom workflows: every action our agents take in the real world runs through your team. Plus our public API, webhooks, and the developer experience that lets partners build on top of us. If you re excited to design APIs, ship agent tooling, and own a surface that gets more strategic every quarter, this might be a great fit. We re reshaping our product function around three pillars, AI, Integrations, and Core, with a PM in each, operating directly with our founder and CPO Mika. This role is for Integrations. Learn how product is built from the inside, working side by side with our CPO. As our Associate Product Manager, you ll work directly with our CPO as a force multiplier for the product team. Resulting from 5 years of collaboration between world-renowned experts from Necker Hospital and Ecole Polytechnique, Sonio uses artificial intelligence to improve prenatal screening and diagnosis. Based on patented algorithms and a proprietary expert database, Sonio aims to become the reference tool to help practitioners improve screening, reduce diagnostic errors, and optimize pregnant women’s medical path. Sonio's mission is to improve women's and children's health by promoting access and quality of care through technological innovation, medical expertise, and collective intelligence. About the role We are looking for a DS/ML Engineer intern to join our Data Science team. Your mission will at the crossing of R&D, ML Engineering and product, supervised by senior ML engineers. You will work on developing of our existing Deep Learning/Computer Vision pipelines using State-of-the-art algorithms. jobs.title: Rekrutmen Badan Amil Zakat Nasional (BAZNAS)
jobs.description: Badan Amil Zakat Nasional (BAZNAS) adalah badan resmi dan satu-satunya yang dibentuk oleh pemerintah berdasarkan Keputusan Presiden RI No. 8 Tahun 2001 yang memiliki tugas dan fungsi menghimpun dan menyalurkan zakat, infak, dan sedekah (ZIS) pada tingkat nasional. Berikut ini lowongan kerja Badan Amil Zakat Nasional (BAZNAS). Lahirnya Undang-Undang Nomor 23 Tahun 2011 tentang Pengelolaan Zakat semakin mengukuhkan peran BAZNAS sebagai lembaga yang berwenang melakukan pengelolaan zakat secara nasional. Dalam UU tersebut, BAZNAS dinyatakan sebagai lembaga pemerintah nonstruktural yang bersifat mandiri dan bertanggung jawab kepada Presiden melalui Menteri Agama. Dalam mengelola zakat, BAZNAS menerapkan prinsip 3A, yakni Aman Syari, Aman Regulasi, dan Aman NKRI. Aman Syari artinya pengelolaan zakat yang dilaksanakan BAZNAS harus selaras dengan koridor hukum syari. Pengelolaan zakat harus selaras dan tidak boleh bertentangan dengan sumber hukum Islam, Al-Quran dan Sunnah.
